links.comparator_used: Models without a drift adaptive framework (static, non-adapted models)
links.outcome: Predictive performance (error) for hospital stay and ICU stay after drift
links.effect: Models with a drift adaptive framework (adaptive, incremental, ensemble learning) performed better than models without one; no numeric difference given in the abstract
links.quote: Furthermore, the models that incorporate a drift adaptive framework exhibit superior performance compared to the models that do not include such a framework.

links.comparator_used: Other models and adaptation strategies tested in the study (e.g., adaptive and incremental learning, individual models)
links.outcome: Mean absolute error for predicting hospital stay and ICU stay
links.effect: Ensemble model achieved minimum MAE of 10.684 (hospital stay) and 2.827 (ICU stay)
links.quote: Through a detailed analysis of the results, the study confirms the superior performance of ensemble model, achieving a minimum mean absolute error (MAE) of 10.684 and 2.827 for predicting hospital stay and ICU stay, respectively.
